messages:
Jules (Marketing): Quick request — can we build a one-page 'Deployment Snapshot: Lightning' for the webinar pre-read? Should help buyers pick Hosted / Dedicated / Private in ~30s. Keep copy micro, shareable slide + accessible PDF.
Marco (Product): Agreed. Include a 3-column micro-compare, 2 labeled benchmark callouts ("example workload"), 1-line migration path, and a tiny runtime note about model fallbacks & KV caching.
Asha (Field): Must list KMS/HSM, VPC peering, and audit log retention options. Add a short FinServ example and 1-line discovery snippets for field.
Ben (Sales): Also want inbound routing heuristics for ops: SDR -> AE -> SE. One-line CTA for the launch post (15-min infra consult).
Jules (Marketing): Proposed micro-layout:
- 1-line lead + Risk vs Speed vs Cost pill
- 3-column quick table (Security / SLA & latency / Cost at scale / Time to ship)
- Side: 2 benchmark nuggets + 3 persona 1-liners
- Footer: routing rules + CTA link
Marco (Product): Benchmark callouts (label as example workload):
- Hosted: 95th-pctl ~100ms @ 1k qps, 128-token avg (example workload)
- Dedicated: reserved GPUs -> ~30-40% lower unit cost at steady >1M tokens/day (example workload)
Add note: Dedicated has SLA-backed latency tiers; Hosted is best-effort with region fallback.
Asha (Field): Persona one-liners for discovery:
- Platform Lead: "Dedicated for predictable throughput and private VPCs."
- CISO: "Private deployment + customer KMS + audit retention for regulated workloads."
- PM: "Hosted = fastest to ship; streaming & tool integrations ready."
Ben (Sales): Routing pseudo-rules for ops (simple):
```
if requires_hsm or data_residency == true or compliance in ["HIPAA","PCI","FedRAMP"]:
  route: AE+SE (high-touch)
elif projected_tokens_per_day >= 1_000_000 or expected_qps >= 800:
  route: AE (dedicated)
else:
  route: SDR -> nurture
```
upload-bot: uploaded 1749999999-lightning-deploy-v0.pdf to thread.
Jules (Marketing): Copy constraints: keep main blurb <100 words, two-tone header, conservative claims, accessible PDF + 1-slide.
Marco (Product): I'll validate numbers and add a 1-line migration path: Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private.
Asha (Field): I'll paste FinServ snippet and discovery lines by EOD.
Ben (Sales): CTA copy for the post: "Which deployment matches your risk profile? Book a 15-min infra consult: https://redwood.ai/book-demo". Will prep AE talking points once copy locks.
Jules (Marketing): Action items:
- Jules: draft one-pager + slide (EOD today)
- Marco: fact-check benchmarks + blurbs (tomorrow AM)
- Asha: field examples + discovery one-liners (tomorrow noon)
- Ben: routing rules to ops + AE snippet (tomorrow afternoon)
- Design: final assets after draft (24h)
Marco (Product): ack.

Jules (Marketing): Thanks team — aim to finalize for webinar pre-read Friday AM. Ping me for blockers. :white_check_mark:
